physical_two_side_exhaustion_and_completion assumes Physical H, Dephased H and positive invariants. It represents existing side blocks and their forced fourth block; it is not a construction from seed data.
strict_physical_matrix_reconstruction takes Physical H, Dephased H and positive leadingR. Its existential variables parameterize that pre-existing matrix, not an arbitrary strict seed.

physical_retained_completion_hadamard assumes Physical H, Dephased H and positive leadingR. The flatness proof in physical_strict_corner_retained rewrites the forced block to blockT H and invokes hH.1. Using this as existence for a fresh seed would be circular.

additional_observations: FullMatchingAudit and MatchingAudit print local Fourier-approximation endpoint axioms, including physical_exists_fourier_match. They are not proofs of arbitrary strict-seed matched completion.
FibreNormIdentity requires an infinite normalized row-Gram fibre and proves the single-side ClearedNormIdentity; it does not assert fourth-block row-product norms.

OAI PairAverage/NormalizedPartitions row products concern Fourier moment averages. OAI NormalizedCubic/CubicClassification classify existing Hadamards with cube or square hypotheses; none supplies the missing completion norm.
